$doc: port/PORT.json — the shared-identical manifest (0.4.0-sync-plan.md §1.2, 0.4.2-plan.md §4 B2; the second contract added by the 0.4.4 M1 bump). Every file listed here is byte-identical with the counterpart (planet-geotectonics) and asserted by experiments/port-check.js on this side and a matching test on that side. A byte that drifts on one side is a shared file that is no longer shared: the sha256 is the drift gate, not a review. The directory now carries two independently testable contracts — pgt-slice-pack-v2 and pgt-core-log-v2 (slice 0.4.4 §2 P2/P3, answered by globe 0.8.4 §2) — and each file's `what` names its own; the manifest format and version are unchanged because the file list, not the schema, is what grew. The two deposit catalogues that used to sit here are no longer a shared contract (the globe deleted them upstream before 0.6.3): at this cutover they moved, values frozen, to js/data/deposit-models.js and js/data/deposit-economics.js as ordinary section-local modules (0.4.2-plan.md D2).
